# MenuRenderer

Namespace `Nfty.Core.Publish` in assembly `Nfty.Core`.

```csharp
public static class MenuRenderer
```

Renders a rolled [`AssetTicket`](../nfty-ticket/Nfty.Ticket.AssetTicket.md) back into pixels from the `.mnu` it was rolled against — the read-side counterpart to [`MenuWriter`](Nfty.Core.Publish.MenuWriter.md). `Nfty.Ticket` is deliberately dependency-free and decodes no pixels, so the half of "roll a ticket, then render it" that touches ImageSharp lives here rather than there, the same split `MenuWriter`'s own remarks describe for writing.

## Remarks

This is the ONE render loop: `serve` and `MenuFidelityTests` both call it rather than each carrying their own copy, because two renderers is how "the client cooks the same dish the server rolled" stops being true.

## Methods

### Render(MenuArchive, AssetTicket) { #m-render-nfty-ticket-menuarchive-nfty-ticket-assetticket }

```csharp
public static Image<Rgba32> Render(MenuArchive menu, AssetTicket ticket);
```

Renders a ticket: plates it into draws ([`Plating.Plate()`](../nfty-ticket/Nfty.Ticket.Plating.md#m-plate-nfty-ticket-menuarchive-nfty-ticket-assetticket)), crops each layer's art out of the Menu's atlas (or takes it whole, in loose mode), colorizes Dynamic/Static layers and leaves Custom ones as-is, then composites.

**Parameters**

- `menu` (`MenuArchive`) - The Menu the ticket was rolled against.
- `ticket` (`AssetTicket`) - The roll to render.

**Returns.** The composited asset. The caller owns and disposes it.

**Exceptions**

- `KeyNotFoundException` - See [`Plating.Plate()`](../nfty-ticket/Nfty.Ticket.Plating.md#m-plate-nfty-ticket-menuarchive-nfty-ticket-assetticket).
- `FormatException` - See [`Plating.Plate()`](../nfty-ticket/Nfty.Ticket.Plating.md#m-plate-nfty-ticket-menuarchive-nfty-ticket-assetticket).
